items.title: Changesets v3: Bumps Peer Dependents by Patch and Ships ESM Only with an 88% Smaller Install
items.blurb: Changesets v3.0, released on August 11, 2026, introduces significant updates for JavaScript monorepos. It offers leaner installations, a rebuilt CLI, and changes to peer dependency management that resolve long-standing complaints.

items.title: Amazon ECS now provides real-time deployment observability in the AWS Management Console
items.blurb: Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) now provides real-time service deployment observability in the Amazon ECS Console for native Linear, Canary, and Blue/Green deployment strategies.

items.title: Amazon EVS now in scope for FedRAMP Class C
items.blurb: The Amazon Elastic VMware Service (EVS) service is now in scope for FedRAMP Class C (formerly Moderate baseline) in all United States Regions.

items.title: Java News Roundup: JDK 27, Open J Proxy, A2A Jakarta, Azul Payara, BoxLang, Netflix ja
items.blurb: This week's Java roundup for September 14th, 2026, features news highlighting: the GA release of JDK 27, LibericaJDK 27, Open J Proxy 1.0 and A2A Jakarta 1.0; point releases of Azul Payara, JHipster, JetBrains Ktor and BoxLang; and…

items.title: Amazon EC2 I7ie instances now available in AWS Israel region
items.blurb: AWS is announcing starting today, Amazon EC2 I7ie instances are now available in AWS Israel (Tel Aviv) region.

items.title: Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available
items.blurb: Amazon Connect Talent is now generally available, giving talent acquisition leaders an AI-powered hiring solution that accelerates candidate selection at scale.

items.title: AWS STS simplifies session token size limits and adds session token size monitoring
items.blurb: AWS Security Token Service (STS) now enforces a single 4,096-byte size limit on session tokens.

items.title: AWS Step Functions adds new AWS service integrations automatically, starting with AWS Lambda MicroVMs
items.blurb: AWS Step Functions now automatically adds AWS SDK integrations for new AWS services and capabilities within weeks of their release, starting with AWS Lambda MicroVMs, AWS Lambda Core and others.
